summary: Allow a strictly source-bound successor Owner PWA package to reuse an explicit, already verified installed-tree baseline manifest while preserving the existing version-local default behavior.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Existing Owner PWA package builder and its strict clean-source, input-hash, baseline-readback, and payload validation gates; owner directed reuse of the verified v1.0.9 installed baseline for the redesigned successor.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: scripts/hbnf_build_local_owner_pwa.py baseline manifest selection only. Omitted option preserves the prior version-local lookup. Explicit paths under the clean checkout are bound into strict source verification and the package source-input manifest.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert the explicit baseline-manifest option and its focused test. Existing builds without the option keep the same version-local baseline resolution.
evidence_sources: Existing v1.0.10 BASELINE.SHA256SUMS and INSTALLED-V1.0.9-READBACK.json; both remain unchanged.
Owner instruction 2026-10-22 to use v1.0.9 as the actual installed baseline and preserve the strict source/commit gate.
tests: Focused builder test proves legacy version-local resolution is unchanged and a successor can explicitly resolve the exact existing v1.0.9 baseline manifest.
Strict source binding requires the explicit baseline to exist inside the checkout and match the pinned commit before packaging.
